Microsoft Visual Studio 2019 Version 16.11.2 complains about missing abs() function declaration. Weirdly, adding `#include <stdlib.h>` at the top of this file does not solve the issue.
I added the include only to template, but not to epan/dissectors/packet-ieee1609dot2.c. Adding it there fixes the issue.
